cut_retry.prompt: Your previous attempt at this task reasoned past the 16384-token limit and was cut off before it gave an answer. This time you must stay within the limit: keep your reasoning under 8000 tokens, do not re-check steps you have already settled, and stop reasoning as soon as you have a plan. Your whole reply, reasoning included, must fit within 16384 tokens.
cut_retry.when: the first call ends at length

forced_answer.prompt: Your thinking has reached its limit. Do not reason any further: give your final answer now, in exactly the format the task asks for.
forced_answer.when: the second call also ends at length, with text to hand back

config.prompt_ceiling: Think briefly. Use at most five sentences of reasoning before you answer. Your whole reply, reasoning included, must fit within 16384 tokens; anything past that is cut off and lost. If you are running out of room, stop reasoning and give your best answer immediately.
config.system_prompt: You are the planner assistant who comes up with correct plans.
